security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from OpenXML namespaces, markdown code fences, XML examples, and C# sample syntax. The real risks are install-time behavior: setup scripts can run privileged package managers, download and execute an external installer from /tmp, alter shell and NuGet configuration, and the skill directs agents toward generated C# execution for complex work.

remediation.issue: Setup scripts perform privileged package installation.
remediation.suggestion: Make setup fully opt-in, remove automatic sudo paths from the default workflow, and list exact package commands for manual review.

remediation.issue: The Unix setup downloads dotnet-install.sh into /tmp and executes it without verification.
remediation.suggestion: Use mktemp, pin the installer source, verify checksums or signatures, and avoid executing downloaded files from a shared temp path.

remediation.issue: Setup can persistently modify user configuration such as ~/.bashrc and NuGet sources.
remediation.suggestion: Ask before editing user profile files or package sources, and prefer project-local configuration that can be removed cleanly.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends generated C# for complex document operations without a sandbox boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to review generated C# before execution and constrain outputs to user-approved workspace paths.

content.value_statement: Manual DOCX formatting is slow and easy to break. This skill provides OpenXML workflows for creating, editing, validating, and templating Word documents.
actual_capabilities: Creates new DOCX documents such as reports, letters, memos, and academic documents.
Edits existing DOCX files through text replacement, placeholder filling, table updates, and metadata changes.
Applies template styles, numbering, themes, section properties, headers, and footers to source documents.
Runs OpenXML validation, business-rule checks, run merging, order repair, and document diffs.
Previews DOCX text and converts legacy DOC files when optional tools are installed.
Provides detailed OpenXML samples for tables, images, lists, fields, comments, track changes, and typography.
limitations: Requires .NET SDK 8 or newer, and optional tools such as pandoc or LibreOffice for some workflows.
Setup scripts may install packages, download dependencies, and change local configuration.
Some Word fields, such as table of contents entries, may still need refresh in Microsoft Word.
Complex templates can require custom C# work and careful validation before delivery.

best_practices: Run environment checks before document work, and review any setup script before allowing installation changes.
Validate every generated or modified DOCX before delivering it to the user.
Use the closest sample or scenario guide instead of inventing OpenXML element order or formatting values.
anti_patterns: Do not run setup scripts automatically in a sensitive environment without reviewing package installs and configuration changes.
Do not edit raw DOCX XML manually when the OpenXML SDK helpers can preserve schema order.
Do not apply a template without checking that source content, section breaks, headers, and footers were preserved.

faq.question: What file format does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Microsoft Word DOCX files and uses OpenXML-based tooling for structure and formatting.

faq.question: Does it require Microsoft Word?
faq.answer: No. It can create and edit DOCX files without Word, but Word may be useful for final field refresh and visual review.

faq.question: Can it convert old DOC files?
faq.answer: Yes, when LibreOffice is available. The conversion helper uses soffice to convert DOC files to DOCX.

faq.question: Can it preserve an existing template?
faq.answer: Yes. It can copy styles, numbering, themes, section properties, headers, and footers from a template.

faq.question: What should users review before setup?
faq.answer: Users should review package manager commands, external downloads, NuGet configuration changes, and shell profile edits.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
